reviews.title: Recommended case for anyone who is the first time PC builder and want a low price budget case
reviews.comment: For a first time PC builder I will recommend this case it is a low price and very easy to build in case it may seem flimsy at the beginning but once you put everything in it's really sturdy it's easy to remove the glass and put new components in if you need to replace any I can say it probably can fit a decent amount of gpu for its size and also maybe a few extra fans up top if you want to add them. The components in the PC is very cool airflow is pretty nice the coloring is bright and makes your PC look nice PC specs Ryzen 5 5500 CPU Corsair cx750m power supply B550 mk motherboard RTX 3050 GPU 1 TB crucial 310 Gen 4 nvme 2280 m2 ssd
reviews.author: Dsboy33

reviews.title: Great quality!
reviews.comment: Quite impressed with this case.  Fans are on a single fan and rgb cable.  So no chasing stuff all over the place.  Fans are quiet but effective to keep air moving through.  Excellent value for the cost!
reviews.author: Over Yondur

reviews.title: Seems to be a decent budget case
reviews.comment: This is an interesting offering for an ATX case. It is pretty straightforward to build in but lacks a bit for access from the rear to the front. Most notably you have to run the CPU power cable behind/between the motherboard and case to come out in a hidden run sort of way. Otherwise, it would just be running across the motherboard. If the power supply is a model with thick wires/sleeve that routing may not even be possible, so one hole there would be nice. The front and bottom as related to the motherboard are workable. The lighted fans are just molex, no speed control, but the description was clear that this was the case. They all spin up without making an insane amount of noise and the color is soft and welcome. Ventilation seems to be adequate with the fans as is. The motherboard tray comes with the standoffs set for an M-ATX motherboard. For the particular ATX motherboard I am using the parts pack was short one standoff. I was able to find something suitable in my parts bowl, but others may not have anything on hand. There are a few sharp edges inside but found that overall, the look and feel of the case is good particularly when together. I do find it a bit odd that this case is apparently the same as another model using a metal door on the glass side. The same sort of slide to fasten 'holes' are visible through the glass. IMO this is a workable ATX solution for a budget build.
reviews.author: M Jordan

reviews.title: Cheap and effective
reviews.comment: Solid case, easy to use/assemble. One complaint is that one of the fans gets in the way when installing the motherboard. Also, the wires are quite a mess. That being said, they were not huge issues and other cases might have the same issues.
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.title: Nightmare Case With Zero Thought Put Into Design
reviews.comment: Cool looking case at first glance, but that’s where the positives end. The fans are cheap and there’s no way to control the RGB colors. Competitors in the same price range offer full control, so this feels like a big downgrade. Cable management is the worst I’ve ever dealt with. The motherboard sits almost flush with the top of the case, which makes clean routing basically impossible. Forget about neat cables or installing top exhaust fans, but there’s simply no space. This is marketed as a mid-tower, but it’s noticeably smaller. I own two other mid-towers and they’re easily 20% bigger. Everything feels cramped. Building in this case was a nightmare. Tight clearances everywhere, constant re-routing, and nothing lines up comfortably. Cooling is at best below average. Because of the limited space, adding extra fans for proper airflow isn’t really an option. Overall, I regret buying this case. I’m already ordering a different one while writing this review.
reviews.author: Denny
